notes: 2015-16 five Spanish UCL: Sevilla UEFA Europa League winners, top four regular league qualifiers.
Marc-André ter Stegen 0/0 La Liga but 13 UCL and 8 Copa 2014-15 as first-choice cup goalkeeper, exception explicitly logged.
Barcelona 4-3-3: Messi RW, Suárez ST, Neymar LW. Atlético & Villarreal 4-4-2, composite 4-2-3-1 not proven most common.
Real Madrid Toni Kroos DM 36 starts, Messi 43 league goals and Cristiano Ronaldo 48, all player impact graded not club league standing.
Two-source DOB, older league season personal impacts, and game-specific majority positions NOT fully certified.
Several nominal backup players had starter-equivalent role, and one athlete may have zero La Liga starts with major cup starts.
BDFutbol goalkeeper negative G reflects conceded, not scored; GK league goals always set zero.
Every player grade and rank proposed, not user-approved.
